name: SwapVM ISA
encoding: one-byte opcode followed by fixed immediate bytes
binaryOperandConvention: b is the top stack word, a is the next word, result is a OP b
stackSignatureConvention: arguments are written deepest-to-top; the rightmost named argument is popped first
limitsSource: sealed WorldConfig bounded by SwapVM v1 hard ceilings

opcodes.name: STOP
opcodes.semantics: successful frame halt with empty output

opcodes.name: ADD
opcodes.semantics: a+b modulo 2^256

opcodes.name: MUL
opcodes.semantics: a*b modulo 2^256

opcodes.name: SUB
opcodes.semantics: a-b modulo 2^256

opcodes.name: DIV
opcodes.semantics: unsigned a/b; zero if b is zero

opcodes.name: SDIV
opcodes.semantics: signed a/b; zero if b is zero; minimum/-1 returns minimum

opcodes.name: MOD
opcodes.semantics: unsigned a%b; zero if b is zero

opcodes.name: SMOD
opcodes.semantics: signed remainder with sign of a; zero if b is zero

opcodes.name: ADDMOD
opcodes.semantics: (a+b)%m at unbounded intermediate precision; zero if m is zero

opcodes.name: MULMOD
opcodes.semantics: (a*b)%m at unbounded intermediate precision; zero if m is zero

opcodes.name: EXP
opcodes.semantics: a**b modulo 2^256

opcodes.name: LT
opcodes.semantics: one iff unsigned a<b

opcodes.name: GT
opcodes.semantics: one iff unsigned a>b

opcodes.name: SLT
opcodes.semantics: one iff signed a<b

opcodes.name: SGT
opcodes.semantics: one iff signed a>b

opcodes.name: EQ
opcodes.semantics: one iff a equals b

opcodes.name: ISZERO
opcodes.semantics: one iff value is zero

opcodes.name: AND
opcodes.semantics: bitwise and

opcodes.name: OR
opcodes.semantics: bitwise or

opcodes.name: XOR
opcodes.semantics: bitwise xor

opcodes.name: NOT
opcodes.semantics: bitwise complement

opcodes.name: BYTE
opcodes.semantics: byte index b of word a, counted from the most-significant end; zero for b>=32

opcodes.name: SHL
opcodes.semantics: a shifted left by b; zero for b>=256

opcodes.name: SHR
opcodes.semantics: unsigned a shifted right by b; zero for b>=256

opcodes.name: SAR
opcodes.semantics: signed arithmetic a shifted right by b with sign extension

opcodes.name: KECCAK256
opcodes.semantics: keccak256(memory[offset:offset+size])

opcodes.name: ECRECOVER
opcodes.semantics: recover low-s secp256k1 signer and return tagged EOA AccountId or zero

opcodes.name: ADDRESS
opcodes.semantics: active mini-contract AccountId

opcodes.name: CALLER
opcodes.semantics: immediate caller AccountId

opcodes.name: CALLDATALOAD
opcodes.semantics: 32-byte zero-padded calldata word at offset

opcodes.name: CALLDATASIZE
opcodes.semantics: current frame calldata byte length

opcodes.name: CALLDATACOPY
opcodes.semantics: copy calldata[source:source+size] to memory[destination:] with zero padding

opcodes.name: RETURNDATASIZE
opcodes.semantics: most recent child return-data byte length

opcodes.name: RETURNDATACOPY
opcodes.semantics: copy child return data; source+size beyond result is exceptional halt

opcodes.name: TIMESTAMP
opcodes.semantics: current chain block timestamp

opcodes.name: NUMBER
opcodes.semantics: current chain block number

opcodes.name: POP
opcodes.semantics: discard top word

opcodes.name: MLOAD
opcodes.semantics: load 32-byte memory word

opcodes.name: MSTORE
opcodes.semantics: store 32-byte value at memory offset

opcodes.name: MSTORE8
opcodes.semantics: store low byte of value at memory offset

opcodes.name: SLOAD
opcodes.semantics: load active contract storage slot

opcodes.name: SSTORE
opcodes.semantics: store value in active contract storage slot

opcodes.name: JUMP
opcodes.semantics: jump to validated JUMPDEST byte offset

opcodes.name: JUMPI
opcodes.semantics: jump to destination iff condition is nonzero

opcodes.name: PC
opcodes.semantics: current opcode byte offset

opcodes.name: MSIZE
opcodes.semantics: current frame memory size in bytes

opcodes.name: JUMPDEST
opcodes.semantics: valid dynamic jump destination

opcodes.name: PUSH0
opcodes.semantics: push zero

opcodes.name: PUSH1..PUSH32
opcodes.semantics: push big-endian immediate

opcodes.name: DUP1..DUP16
opcodes.semantics: duplicate selected existing stack word; underflow if absent

opcodes.name: SWAP1..SWAP16
opcodes.semantics: swap top with selected stack word; underflow if absent

opcodes.name: LOG0..LOG4
opcodes.semantics: append virtual record using active emitter, topics in topic0..topicN-1 order, and memory[offset:offset+size] data

opcodes.name: TXACTOR
opcodes.semantics: root authenticated AccountId

opcodes.name: WORLDID
opcodes.semantics: current PoolId

opcodes.name: EXECUTIONHEIGHT
opcodes.semantics: height assigned to current successful execution candidate

opcodes.name: ETHIN
opcodes.semantics: exact outer ETH input

opcodes.name: TOKENOUT
opcodes.semantics: gross outer TOKEN output before VM burn

opcodes.name: TICK
opcodes.semantics: post-swap int24 tick sign-extended to 256 bits

opcodes.name: LIQUIDITY
opcodes.semantics: post-swap active v4 liquidity

opcodes.name: BYTEPRICE
opcodes.semantics: immutable TOKEN units per executed byte

opcodes.name: BYTESUSED
opcodes.semantics: shared executed-byte count including current opcode

opcodes.name: BYTESREMAINING
opcodes.semantics: root byte limit minus bytes used

opcodes.name: CREATE
opcodes.semantics: instantiate registered codeHash with constructor calldata from memory and return AccountId

opcodes.name: CALL
opcodes.semantics: call same-World target with memory input; retain full child return data; copy min(outputSize,returnDataSize) bytes to outputOffset; push one; child failure propagates

opcodes.name: RETURN
opcodes.semantics: successful frame halt with memory output

opcodes.name: STATICCALL
opcodes.semantics: CALL with static flag inherited by descendants and identical return-data handling

opcodes.name: REVERT
opcodes.semantics: revert complete root execution with memory error data
